scripts.dev: concurrently -n WEB,SERVER -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @lumio/web" "npm run dev --workspace @lumio/server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lumio/shared && npm run build --workspace @lumio/server && npm run build --workspace @lumio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @lumio/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @lumio/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @lumio/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @lumio/web && npm run lint --workspace @lumio/server
